acf.s005_p: The U.S. investor visa and green card routes for entrepreneurs and investors
acf.s011_p: For EB-5 investors, the timing of your filing is key to managing costs and legal risk. The September 30, 2026 date directly affects the US$800,000 investment amount, your legal rights, and the stability of your petition.
acf.s012_p: ! Grandfathering — protection for filed petitions
acf.s013_p: Under the EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022 (RIA), only Form I-526E petitions filed by September 30, 2026 are grandfathered under the current requirements if the program is changed later.
acf.s023_p: Each program suits a different goal, budget and business model for investors and entrepreneurs who want to settle in the United States. They fall into 2 groups: investing directly for a green card, and immigrating as a business owner.
acf.s027_h2:
Invest directly for a U.S. green card
(EB-5, EB-1C)
acf.s028_p: These programs lead directly to a U.S. green card for you, your spouse and your children under 21.
acf.s047_p: Invest in a project that meets U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) requirements, for at least 5 years.
acf.s049_p: A green card for you, your spouse and your children under 21
acf.s050_p: Live, work and study anywhere in the United States
acf.s051_p: Access to healthcare, education and most public benefits on the same terms as U.S. citizens, other than the right to vote
acf.s052_p: Free public schooling for your children through high school
acf.s053_p: In-state tuition — about one-third of what international students pay
acf.s054_p: After 5 years as a green card holder, you are eligible to apply for U.S. citizenship
acf.s056_p: Not a fast route — you wait for a visa number to become available
acf.s073_p: You already own a U.S. company that has operated for at least 1 year, is performing well and has a workable growth plan.
acf.s075_p: A green card for you, your spouse and your children under 21
acf.s076_p: Live, work and study anywhere in the United States
acf.s077_p: Access to healthcare, education and most public benefits on the same terms as U.S. citizens, other than the right to vote
acf.s078_p: Free public schooling for your children through high school
acf.s079_p: In-state tuition — about one-third of what international students pay
acf.s080_p: After 5 years as a green card holder, you are eligible to apply for U.S. citizenship
acf.s082_p: Only if you already own a U.S. business
acf.s083_p: It can be hard to prove your role and why the business needs you
acf.s088_p: B The entrepreneur route
acf.s089_h2:
Move to the U.S. as a business owner
(L-1A, E-2)
acf.s090_p: Two visa programs for entrepreneurs who will run a business in the United States, with a possible path to a green card later.
acf.s092_p: As fast as 15 business days
acf.s109_li: Move to the United States to run and work in your subsidiary
acf.s110_li: Give your children a U.S. education
acf.s112_p: Set up a U.S. subsidiary and transfer an executive or senior manager from the parent company abroad to run it.
acf.s114_li: Parent company abroad: substantial in size, with the financial capacity to invest in the United States
acf.s115_li: U.S. company: a subsidiary or affiliate, large enough to require an executive or senior manager to run it
acf.s117_li: Currently employed in a managerial or executive capacity at the parent company abroad
acf.s118_li: Has the capability and experience to run the U.S. subsidiary
acf.s120_p: Very fast — as little as 15 business days with premium processing
acf.s121_p: Your whole family can live, study and work in the United States
acf.s122_p: Free public schooling through high school for children under 21
acf.s123_p: After 1 year of successful operations, you may apply for EB-1C — a route to a green card and U.S. citizenship
acf.s125_p: You must show the business is trading well from year one to qualify for an extension
acf.s126_p: Visa valid 1–3 years, up to 7 years in total — renewal depends on how the business performs
acf.s143_li: Live in the United States to run a business and invest
acf.s144_li: Give your children a U.S. education
acf.s145_li: Keep a U.S. base without settling permanently
acf.s146_li: Plan your U.S. tax position around the time you spend there
acf.s148_p: Invest in a new or existing U.S. business.
acf.s150_p: You must hold citizenship of an E-2 treaty country: Grenada, Türkiye (Turkey), Montenegro and others.
acf.s151_p: If you obtained that citizenship by investment, you must also have been domiciled in that country for at least 3 continuous years before applying for E-2
acf.s153_p: You, your spouse and your children under 21 can work, do business and study in the United States
acf.s154_p: Own a U.S. business and draw its profits
acf.s155_p: Whether you pay U.S. tax on worldwide income depends on how long you spend in the United States — confirm your position with an independent tax advisor
acf.s156_p: Free public schooling for your children through high school
acf.s158_p: Requires citizenship of an E-2 treaty country and, where that citizenship was obtained by investment, 3 years of domicile there
acf.s159_p: Visa valid 2–5 years — renewal depends on how the U.S. business performs
